item.tib: pha rgyud rig pa khu byug gsang mchog mthar thug rgyal po las zhi ba a dkar tshangs pa
item.coloph: gsang sngags gsang ba'i lung don/ gsas mkhar mchog lnga'i rtsa ba/ nyon mong log pa'i spa bkong*/ dus gsum 'khor ba gtan sprugs/ zhi ba a dkar tshangs pa ces pa/ 'chi med gtsug phud kyi lung don/ gsang ba 'dus pa'i man ngag stag la me 'bar gyi thugs dam/ lha klu mi gsum gyis gtan la phab nas/ bsgrags pa gsum gyis mdor bsdus te/ nam mkha' snang ba'i mdog can la gtad do/ des lho yi gshen gsum la brgyud do/ des zhang zhung gi gshen gsum la brgyud do/ des khod spungs dran pa nam mkha' la brgyud do/ des rje blon ldang gsum ra sangs khad (khod) ram dang bzhi la brgyud do/ des phyi rabs las ldan gyi gshen la brgyud do/ des sgo yi btsun pa rgyal mtshan 'od zer la brgyud do/ de nas rim par brgyud nas da lta bdag gis zhus so//
